blockers.quote: In one taste test, students were told, "This is your last chocolate."
blockers.why: The viewer's week: a chocolate taste test is not chai, the bus or metro, exams, the office, or family. Two facts in a row while the stall scene stands still, so I stop watching on this line.
blockers.fix: Replace this line and the next ("64% picked it as their favourite. Any flavour (c02).") with: The stall outside college never tasted like this. You were always going back tomorrow.

blockers.quote: 64% picked it as their favourite. Any flavour (c02).
blockers.why: The viewer's week: the same off-week example, and the second fact while you are still at the glass. I am already gone.
